rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and correctly notes possible partial collapse and thinned zona, but it overstates certainty of A-grade ICM/TE from this single image and highlights a prominent compact ICM that is not crisply defined visually.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, prior miscarriage, ovarian reserve, semen parameters, endometrium, and day-5 high-grade morphology into prognosis and counseling.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient modifiers; only minor overconfidence in image-based morphology limits a perfect score.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including SET and avoiding unproven add-ons; minor issue is some imprecision around Gardner stage interpretation from the image/text discrepancy.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management, metabolic optimization, failure workup, miscarriage follow-up, and future cycle planning with appropriate nuance.
